question: After the pacing defect is fixed, should ambiguous outbound rows without a reconciliation-capable adapter remain pending/backed off instead of moving to failed?
rationale: Tests can prove either behavior, but the pending-vs-failed choice changes operator expectations and upgrade behavior for existing ambiguous rows.

options.title: Accept Recoverable Pending After Pacing Fix
options.body: Merge once no-op deferrals no longer consume replay pacing and exact-head validation is green, keeping the broader ledger and operator surface in the canonical issue.

options.title: Keep Fail-Closed State
options.body: Close or pause this PR and keep current main's terminal failed behavior until full delivery reconciliation is designed.

options.title: Require Operator Surface First
options.body: Ask for a visible Doctor, UI, or API path before changing ambiguous rows to remain pending longer.

recommendation.title: Accept Recoverable Pending After Pacing Fix
recommendation.body: Merge once no-op deferrals no longer consume replay pacing and exact-head validation is green, keeping the broader ledger and operator surface in the canonical issue.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses SQLite queue state, recovery semantics, and operator behavior, and this owner is tied to the SQLite queue migration history.
